tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: Free. Returns what this server can do, the price of each paid tool, and where to buy an API key.

tools.name: url_to_pdf
tools.description: Render a web page to PDF. Requires an API key purchased at https://url-pdf.hammbox.com/buy. If this MCP request carries a valid "x-api-key" or "Authorization: Bearer" header, it renders directly and returns a 1-hour download URL; otherwise it returns purchase guidance.

tools.name: url_to_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a page as an image. Requires an API key purchased at https://url-pdf.hammbox.com/buy. If this MCP request carries a valid "x-api-key" or "Authorization: Bearer" header, it renders directly and returns a 1-hour download URL; otherwise it returns purchase guidance.

tools.name: url_to_markdown
tools.description: Extract page content as clean Markdown. Requires an API key purchased at https://url-pdf.hammbox.com/buy. If this MCP request carries a valid "x-api-key" or "Authorization: Bearer" header, it renders directly and returns a 1-hour download URL; otherwise it returns purchase guidance.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "url_to_pdf" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
